yt.title: This small cube has {c_q} quintillion positions #Shorts
yt.description:
Positions of a 3x3x3 puzzle cube: 8!·3^7·12!·2^11/2, computed. God's number (20) was proven in 2010.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: This little cube has more positions than you'd believe.
Eight corners, each placed and twisted. Twelve edges, each placed and flipped. Divide by two for parity, and there it is.

scenes.text: Any of them: 20 moves or less
scenes.narration: Yet every single one can be solved in twenty moves or fewer. Proven in twenty ten.
